body.name: Admissible rank-preserving kernel classes
body.construction: \[\mathfrak C^{\mathrm{bal}}_{N,K}(H)=\left\{[\Omega]_{\cong}:\Omega\in\mathfrak K^{\mathrm{bal}}_{N,K},\ [\Omega]_{\cong}\cap\mathcal C_{N,K}(H)\neq\varnothing\right\}.\] Recognition is posed only for an input tensor already in the feasible domain \(\mathfrak K^{\mathrm{bal}}_{N,K}\); equivalently, the input may include a valid law \(p\in\mathfrak P^{\mathrm{bal}}_{N,K}\) that induces it.
